title: gRPC application continuation, not original-stream preservation
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Continue from the application acknowledgement on a new synthetic stream; compare independent native-shaped HTTP/2/gRPC receipts and browser-proxy observations without borrowing proof from HTTP 200.
preconditions: A modern browser capable of opening local HTML with standard JavaScript.
Eight fixed synthetic results, a bounded original clock, and a page-local attempt.
No account, server, credentials, Azure connection, dependency installation, or framework.
actions: Choose acknowledgement, continuation policy, independent native/proxy evidence conditions, resume delay, and original budget.
Start v1, close the original stream at cutover, resume on v2, and check.
Inspect exact dropped/duplicate sequences, wire protocol, gRPC trailers, original-clock budget, and independent verdicts.
Reset with keyboard focus restored; preserve failures and unfinished UNKNOWN outcomes in bounded full-receipt history.
assertions: Checkpoint continuation requests acknowledgement plus one on a different stream; the original stream is not preserved.
Eight expected results occur exactly once in order in each independently observed lane.
HTTP/1.1 JSON and HTTP 200 cannot qualify gRPC; missing trailers or receipts remain UNKNOWN.
Nonzero grpc-status, sequence gaps/duplicates, or an original-budget breach fail despite HTTP or proxy success.
Known failure takes precedence over unsupported or unknown evidence, without rewriting either observer's verdict.
Strict input and phase guards reject unsafe or repeated actions without mutation.
Reset records unfinished attempts as UNKNOWN and retains eight newest complete receipts.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED; before implementation

testRuntime.browser: Offline Playwright 1.56.1 with installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156

limits: Both lanes and all timings are deterministic fixtures, not a real native driver, HTTP exchange, gateway, Azure result, or production Node.js 24 certification.
Browser-proxy success cannot certify native HTTP/2/gRPC or original-stream survival.
Page memory retains eight outcomes; reload closes the local exercise and clears history.
B-S047 still requires CORE, DATA, AKS, C028, C074, a qualified native driver/gateway, target approval, and a separately approved lease.
D-S047 still requires P003, BASE, and its original native acceptance; no source parent is complete.
